bugs.summary: Float truncation: to_cents(19.99) returns 1998, should round.
split_evenly drops the remainder, shares do not add up to the total.
Mutable default dict is shared across Inventory instances.
Off by one: reserving exactly all available units raises, docstring says it is allowed.
Removes from a list while iterating it, skips adjacent matching lines.
Expiry is inclusive per the field comment, comparison should be <=.
best_discount stacks every valid discount, docstring says pick the single best.
parse_qty accepts 0, must be at least 1.
No rollback: if a later line is out of stock, earlier reservations are never released (all-or-none promised).

neutral.summary: add() ignores a different unit price for an existing SKU. Debatable, neither credited nor penalized.
